scope.densityGridEncoding: Original Float32Array bit patterns, eight hexadecimal digits per value; exact bits, no tolerance
scope.geometryEncoding: Original ordered MultiPolygon components/rings/vertices; no ring canonicalization in the oracle checker
scope.uniformMissingInput: Compact grid fixtures use NaN for every missing value. Native D3 null-vs-NaN behavior is preserved separately, never treated as equivalent.
scope.negativeMaximum: Native D3 negative-maximum bulk versus field(value) behavior is preserved separately; no equality claim for their differing endpoints.
